essence: One should sit in the southern shade at the root, filled with compassion.
One should sit properly with respect among sages such as Kauśika.
The initiated companions have minds fixed on the scripture under the supreme lord.
The teaching is declared with exposition and song according to the enjoyment doctrine.
The practitioner may be seated or standing, with or without sages around.
